meta.name: add-dial
meta.description: Add Dial channel integration — a real phone number for SMS and AI voice calls via the Dial platform (getdial.ai). Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给应用接入真实号码,支持短信与AI语音通话
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在开发需要电话或短信能力的应用
copy.tagline_en: Add a real phone number for SMS and AI voice calls to your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app that needs phone or SMS capabilities

howto.what: 给 Claude 装上 Dial:它获得一个真实电话号码,可以收发短信、接听和拨打 AI 语音通话。安装会从 channels 分支复制 Dial 适配器、配对助手和它们的测试,注册频道,再带你登录 Dial、绑定线路。
howto.when: 当你运行 add-dial 技能,或要给 agent 配一个真实电话号码(短信、AI 语音通话)时接管。它会先复制适配器、注册频道,再走登录与配对流程。

say.text: 帮我接入 Dial,给这个 agent 配一个电话号码
say.note: 会复制适配器、注册频道并引导你登录 Dial

say.text: 线路装好了,现在配对我要用来发短信的手机
say.note: 会发 6 位配对码,你把它短信发到 Dial 号码

say.text: 把这个号码的来电问候语改成先问对方找谁

howto.what_en: Adds Dial to Claude: one real phone number for SMS and AI voice calls. Install copies the Dial adapter, pairing helper and their tests from the channels branch, registers the channel, then signs you in to Dial and binds the line.
howto.when_en: Runs when you invoke the add-dial skill or want to give the agent a real phone number for SMS or AI voice calls; it copies the adapter, registers the channel, then signs in and pairs your phone.

say_en.text: Add Dial and give this agent a phone number
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, registers the channel, walks you through Dial sign-in

say_en.text: The line is set up — now pair the phone I'll text from
say_en.note: Sends a 6-digit code you text to the Dial number

say_en.text: Change this number's inbound greeting to ask who's calling
